description: Turn the project's live traffic on or off: real users' conversations, sent through QualiLoop tracing, recorded and judged. Ask the user first; it sends real users' data. Admins only. Only when the user asks about how much is stored or scored: collect_percent, scoring_enabled, score_percent, and limits per day, week or month (turn_limit for stored turns, score_limit for scored conversations; null removes a limit). Left out, what is saved stays.

collect_percent.description: Share of new live conversations stored.

score_limit.description: The most live conversations scored per period; null removes the limit.

score_percent.description: Share of stored live conversations scored.

turn_limit.description: The most live turns stored per period; null removes the limit.

name: connect_set_live
